title: Burp Suite Runner Integration
goal: Add Burp Suite Professional as an alternative web scanner runner alongside ZAP, giving operators the choice of the industry-standard tool for web application testing.
scope: Implement a 'burp' runner in workers/runners/burp/ that interfaces with the Burp Suite REST API (available in Burp Suite Professional via the REST API extension or Burp Suite Enterprise). The runner: (1) Starts a Burp scan against the target URL using the configured Burp REST API endpoint (BURP_API_URL, BURP_API_KEY in settings); (2) Polls the scan status until completion; (3) Retrieves findings from the Burp scan results endpoint; (4) Normalizes Burp findings into AegisPT's finding model with WSTG methodology tags; (5) Stores raw Burp output as an artifact. The runner is optional — if BURP_API_URL is not configured, the burp runner is unavailable and ZAP remains the default web scanner. A new 'passive-web-burp' run profile is added as an alternative to 'passive-web-baseline'. Burp Pro at $475/year means this unlocks the full PortSwigger scanner engine including active scanning, Burp AI, and the 500+ BApp extensions without AegisPT needing to re-implement them.
generation_reason: Burp Suite Pro is the industry standard for web application pentesting — pre-installed in Kali, used by virtually every professional pentester, and now includes Burp AI. Adding it as an optional runner gives AegisPT access to the world's most comprehensive web scanner without reimplementing its capabilities. Operators who already have Burp licenses can use it directly from AegisPT.
